open_debate.question: Should request-to-book (host review/approval of bookings) exist in FitOut v1 at all, or should v1 be instant-book-only?
open_debate.why_it_matters: Request-to-book is the SOLE reason the escrow/authorize/hold/refund-on-decline complexity exists. Instant-book-only removes it entirely.
open_debate.user_leaning: Leaning toward instant-book-only + a cancellation policy with fees. User's key insight: a retained cancellation fee (>= processing fee) makes booker-initiated cancellations self-funding, so the platform never eats a fee — WHEREAS a host REJECTION can't fairly be billed to anyone, so rejection is the only reversal that forces the platform to eat the gateway fee. Remove rejection => remove the only unfunded fee event.
open_debate.status: STILL UP FOR DEBATE — user's exact words. decisions.decision: HARD CONSTRAINT (fact, not a preference): QRPh must be excluded from any request-to-book / approval-gated flow.
decisions.rationale: PayMongo cannot HOLD QRPh (capture-only) AND cannot API-refund QRPh at all. A declined QRPh request leaves funds stuck with only a manual/operator-alert reimbursement path. QRPh stays fine for instant-book (nothing is ever reversed).
decisions.status: Locked as a technical constraint regardless of which scope path is chosen.

research_finding_paymongo_per_rail.summary: PayMongo authorize/hold (manual capture) support, per rail — from a synchronous research agent this session.
research_finding_paymongo_per_rail.cards: HOLD-CAPABLE via Payment Intent capture_type:manual -> awaiting_capture -> POST /v1/payment_intents/{id}/capture (supports partial) OR /cancel (void). BUT it is a sales-gated 'Advanced Card Feature' (must request PayMongo enablement) and the hold AUTO-VOIDS after 7 days (caps any request SLA at <=7d). Void is almost certainly fee-free (docs silent — inferred).
research_finding_paymongo_per_rail.gcash_maya_grabpay: CAPTURE-ONLY (no hold). Refundable, BUT PayMongo confirms the merchant STILL PAYS the processing fee on refunds ('you are still charged the transaction fee for refunded transactions') => ~2.5% fee bleed on every declined request. Partial refunds OK on cards/GCash; Maya same-day = full-refund-only.
research_finding_paymongo_per_rail.qrph: CAPTURE-ONLY and NOT refundable via API at all ('QR Ph payments have no refunds through PayMongo'). => unusable for approval-gated bookings.

cancellation_fee_economics: Confirmed sound for BOOKER-initiated cancellation: booking P1000, processing fee ~P25 (2.5%). Retain P100 cancellation fee, refund P900 (partial refund) => net platform +P75. Any reasonable cancellation fee (>=~2.5%) covers the sunk gateway fee. Works on cards/GCash; Maya same-day = full-refund-only edge; QRPh = no refund (can't apply). Does NOT solve host REJECTION (can't bill booker for host's 'no'; can't bill host for using review) — which is exactly why rejection, unlike cancellation, forces escrow.
airbnb_precedent_discussed: Early couch-surfing-era Airbnb (2008-2012) was approval-heavy (request-to-book was the default) BECAUSE it was intimate; Instant Book came ~2013 and is STILL opt-in per host, enabled only after trust infra (reviews/verified IDs/ratings) matured. FitOut has NO reviews yet (v2/DISC-03) => the trust scaffolding that makes instant-book-on-a-home-gym safe does not exist at launch. This is the strongest live argument for keeping SOME review capability early, or keeping home gyms out of the launch focus.
